author: Codex assessment agent /root/liberal_conservative (AI-assisted doctrinal interpretation)
changeNote: Completed 240 independently considered answers to the current bank from the scoped doctrine. No imported 12Axes vectors or score targets. User authorised neutral answers and completion on 2026-10-04. Conditional modern applications and mixed-causation modelling are explicitly inferred, not claims of direct statements or scientific findings. Independent review completed on 2026-10-04; question-meaning and evidence corrections are recorded in review notes.

metadata.name: Social Liberalism
metadata.description: The social liberal tradition of T. H. Green and L. T. Hobhouse, centred on enabling freedom through public provision and social reform within a market economy.
metadata.scope: The social liberal tradition of T. H. Green and L. T. Hobhouse, centred on enabling freedom through public provision and social reform within a market economy. This is a representative interpretation of the specified doctrine, not answers personally submitted by every adherent. Modern technological questions apply the doctrine conditionally. Trait-specific neutral responses express a stated mixed-causation model where the doctrine rejects a single fixed causal priority; they are not empirical scientific estimates.
metadata.phrase: A society combining civil freedom with education, social security and opportunities that people can actually use.

sources.title: John Stuart Mill on Human Nature, Self-interest, and Institutional Incentives

axes.brief: Hobhouse's New Liberalism combines representative democracy with social conditions for effective participation.
axes.counterEvidence: His second-chamber and referendum proposals qualify simple majoritarianism; financial government remains parliamentary. Hobhouse also entertained capacity-based colonial exceptions (chapter IX); these qualify claims of universal historical practice.

answers.rationale: Popular consent underpins government rather than inherited class control.
Expertise advises a self-governing public; it cannot replace it.
Excluding less educated adults perpetuates unequal political opportunity.
Executive defiance of parliament defeats representative control.
Opposition competition is necessary for genuine democratic choice.
Financial control requires scrutiny across the representative chamber.
Constitutional rights need independent enforcement against government.
Union voice supplements universal citizenship rather than replacing it.
Political exclusion cannot be an incumbent's discretionary privilege.
Hobhouse allows legislative appeals, while distinguishing financial measures.
Public deliberation is incompatible with a leader's sole discretion.
Constitutional removal prevents office from becoming personal dominion.
Convenience cannot suspend the source of democratic authority.
Accountability favours recall, but stable representative deliberation needs protection.
A government of the people must answer to them.
Military guardianship would remove citizens' political agency.

axes.brief: Freedom develops through mutual restraint and aid; Hobhouse rejects coercion as moral improvement.
axes.counterEvidence: Unlike strict harm-principle individualism, social interdependence can justify protective measures.

answers.rationale: Voluntary choice matters, although addiction can undermine effective autonomy.
Independent warrants can protect the community without arbitrary power.
Effective public expression requires tolerating limited inconvenience.
Public criticism enables rational correction of institutions.
Autonomy conflicts with protection of the capacity for autonomy.
Indiscriminate prolonged tracking treats citizens as subjects.
Road users' reciprocal safety supports proportionate testing.
Protection from serious harm must coexist with meaningful judicial safeguards.
Adult moral development requires persuasion rather than censorship.
Unmonitored association supports practical civil freedom.
Generalised suspicion threatens equal treatment and trust.
Specific likely disorder can justify a proportionate restriction.
Secure private space requires independent legal permission for intrusion.
Misconduct disclosure enables community control over public power.
Collective safety outweighs an assumed universal private-arms entitlement.
Unreviewable detention substitutes executive force for rational law.

axes.brief: Common humanity and toleration support cultural inclusion, alongside shared social responsibility.
axes.counterEvidence: Hobhouse recognises relevant differences without endorsing extraneous penalties for beliefs.

answers.rationale: Majority preference cannot itself justify penalising minority customs.
Accommodation supports the effective equality underlying social freedom.
Participation need not require abandoning harmless cultural practices.
Common humanity survives differences of community and belief.
Accessible services and a shared public language both contribute to inclusion.
Minority recognition expresses inclusive social membership.
Cultural spending should reflect the whole cooperating community.
Common rights still constrain particular communal demands.
Reasonable flexibility better fits mutual accommodation than rigid uniformity.
Several traditions can participate in a common civic life.
Social solidarity favours participation beyond isolated communities.
Language assistance can make formal rights practically usable.
Shared solidarity and freely sustained community ties deserve balance.
Conscience deserves accommodation unless a necessary general rule is defeated.
A shared polity does not require identical cultural lives.
Integration should enable cooperation rather than prescribe private identity.

axes.brief: Universal human development supports migration and family unity with collective capacity obligations.
axes.counterEvidence: The historical text is not a visa code; these are modern applications of solidarity and mutual restraint.

answers.rationale: Rigid quotas can disregard individual need and changing capacity.
Self-development supplies a valid reason for lawful movement.
Social membership cannot be reduced to labour-market usefulness.
Family relations contribute directly to effective personal freedom.
Protection against persecution outweighs employability or cultural familiarity.
Humanitarian attachment and lawful administration require individual assessment.
Workers' mobility and sustainable labour conditions can conflict.
Housing provision should expand, but real service limits remain relevant.
Family bonds deserve consideration beyond an undifferentiated quota.
A genuine job offer supports social and economic integration.
Public protection and independent means also justify settlement.

Developed skills and social participation support a graduate route to residence. The route can remain conditional on ordinary legal requirements; rejecting guaranteed status is not a reason to reject a route.
Basic protection should survive exhaustion of economic quotas.
Cultural sorting conflicts with equal human standing.
Resident social security supports genuine participation and mutual aid.
Plurality is valuable without making difference itself a selection rule.

axes.brief: Hobhouse connects international fear with incomplete national freedom and favours cooperation.
axes.counterEvidence: His anti-imperial outlook does not require surrender to armed aggression.

answers.rationale: Prestige or advantage does not justify attacking another society.
Negotiation supports liberty across nations rather than fear.
Arms superiority can deepen insecurity and divert social resources.
An imminent attack can justify necessary defence.
A defensive presumption restrains imperial ventures.
Compulsion requires a clearer emergency than routine military preparation.
Reasonable concessions protect lives and international cooperation.
Unsupervised lethal decisions threaten responsibility and humane restraint.
Defending society is preferable to projecting domination abroad.
Refusing all assistance to an attacked ally undermines solidarity.
Prolonged expeditionary warfare is not a normal social priority.
Territorial prestige cannot outweigh peaceful human development.
Coercive bargaining perpetuates relationships founded on fear.
Avoiding war normally outweighs demonstrations of national prestige.
Defensive information can help peace but provocative espionage may undermine it.
Mutual disarmament can release resources for social development.

axes.brief: International cooperation extends the interdependence and mutual restraint of domestic society.
axes.counterEvidence: National democratic consent remains relevant; internationalism need not mean compulsory federation.

answers.rationale: Shared obligations legitimately constrain unilateral national preference.
Consensually constituted institutions may bind individual governments.
National judges should honour valid common legal commitments.
Stable peace requires durable rather than opportunistic cooperation.
Withdrawal must balance continuing consent against reciprocal obligations.
International accountability protects people from governmental abuse.
Community obligations extend beyond immediate national advantage.
Cross-border harms require jointly empowered solutions.
Common foreign policy may reduce rivalry through cooperation.
Universal liberty can justify agreed international rights enforcement.
Monetary pooling depends on democratic control and social consequences.
Joint provision follows the principle of effective mutual aid.
Shared border arrangements can serve protection and mobility.
Common trade rules support peaceful economic cooperation.
Federation requires popular consent and protection of local freedom.
Enforcing common rules can serve durable freedom beyond immediate gain.

axes.brief: Hobhouse permits collective economic action and public provision while retaining personal initiative.
axes.counterEvidence: He distinguishes socially generated wealth from individual effort rather than demanding universal state ownership.

answers.rationale: Ordinary private businesses can coexist with social obligations.
Network monopolies fit collective provision and accountability.
Ownership should serve social function rather than enjoy automatic preference.
Public enterprise can address important unmet community needs.
Publicly accountable facilities help secure access beyond purchasing power.
Shared rail infrastructure fits coordinated public provision.
Cost savings matter, but accountability and employment conditions also count.
Public banking can counter concentrated financial power.
Selling productive public assets needs more than a private-ownership presumption.
Social housing supplies substantive security and opportunity.
Effective regulation may suffice, but direct control sometimes protects public interests.
Socially created resource rents support public ownership or control.
Routine contracting is acceptable only where broader social duties survive.
Strategic social value can outweigh immediate sale receipts.
Financial losses alone do not establish absence of public value.
Public broadcasting can widen educational and civic opportunity.

axes.brief: The Cobden inheritance favours free exchange while New Liberalism addresses workers' conditions domestically.
axes.counterEvidence: Social reform is not equivalent to tariff protection or mercantilism.

answers.rationale: Producer protection burdens the broader consuming community.
Free exchange remains compatible with social liberal reform.
Public procurement balances social conditions against efficient sourcing.
Private sourcing should generally be free under common safeguards.
Essential resilience may matter without justifying general exclusion.
Unilateral openness can benefit consumers and international cooperation.
Infant protection risks privileging owners over society.
Equal commercial access supports an open cooperating economy.
Farm incomes are better supported directly than through exclusion.
Adaptation with social assistance is preferable to permanent protection.
Retaliation burdens domestic consumers and international relations.
Comparable goods should face origin-neutral taxation.
Countervailing remedies may be justified, but need evidence of distortion.
Open agreements are worthwhile with adequate supply resilience.
Strategic control requires a specific public-interest assessment.
Digital exchange follows openness with common social protections.

axes.brief: Markets operate within collective rules that enable freedom and protect weaker participants.
axes.counterEvidence: New Liberalism is neither laissez-faire nor comprehensive command planning.

answers.rationale: Initiative remains valuable within social regulation.
Output compulsion is excessive for ordinary competitive industries.
Market prices inform activity, subject to public-interest corrections.
Public investment can coordinate opportunities markets neglect.
Demand matters, but abrupt closure can justify transition support.
Essential affordability can justify intervention where exploitation occurs.
Entry should normally be open under social safeguards.
Priority lending may help inclusion but risks political favouritism.
Capital mobility is useful until it undermines essential social obligations.
Socially useful development may require public investment support.
Monetary choice and collective financial stability need reconciliation.
A wage floor improves workers' effective bargaining freedom.
Negotiation with a protected floor fits social cooperation.
Employment goals matter, but monetary institutions need credible constraints.
Tenant security and supply incentives call for context-sensitive rules.
Comprehensive ordinary planning would displace plural social initiative.

axes.brief: Hobhouse treats social rights and the social contribution to wealth as grounds for redistribution.
axes.counterEvidence: He retains rewards for effort; social justice is not mechanical equality of every income.

answers.rationale: Redistribution corrects social disadvantages that obstruct effective freedom.
Income concentration can itself weaken equitable social opportunity.
A stronger minimum supports self-development rather than mere survival.
Social membership requires more than an austere relief floor.
Greater capacity and socially enabled gains warrant progressive contributions.
Lower taxes are not preferable when they undermine social rights.
Inheritance taxation can return socially generated opportunity to the community.
Arbitrary expiration conflicts with continuing social need.
Concentrated wealth can fairly contribute to social provision.
Adequacy cannot be subordinated simply to contributors' lower taxes.
Participation is a substantive component of social freedom.
Unmet social needs can take priority over tax reductions.
Supporting low-paid work strengthens effective opportunity.
Uniform marginal rates ignore unequal capacity and social advantage.
Compensated land reform can correct concentrated unearned opportunity.
Social citizenship extends beyond households facing immediate destitution.

axes.brief: Freedom of conscience and civic equality separate state authority from clerical privilege.
axes.counterEvidence: Voluntary religious education remains possible; Hobhouse distinguishes relevant educational choice from unrelated discrimination.

answers.rationale: Civil reasons enable equal membership across religious differences.
Faith-based legislative authority privileges some consciences over others.
Public policy requires civic rather than clerical authorisation.
Confessional state foundations risk unequal citizenship.
Shared schooling should inform without coercing religious assent.
Official conversion-oriented teaching compromises pupils' conscience.
Common civil law secures equal treatment between faiths.

Hobhouse separates doctrinal religion from state mechanisms; this supports ordinary civic participation rather than a religious office carrying privileged official legislative review, even if that review is only advisory.
Common ceremonies should include believers and non-believers equally.
Public aid should serve welfare rather than belief cultivation itself.
Official endorsement can alienate equal citizens of other beliefs.
Shared rest days and confessional recognition are distinct considerations.
Religious office is no substitute for democratic accountability.
Fiscal preferences need a social-service rather than sectarian basis.
Family civil status must not depend on clerical permission.
Religious arbitration cannot override equal individual civil protections.

axes.brief: Growth of personality supports equal respect and reform of restrictive custom.
axes.counterEvidence: These contemporary applications do not imply Hobhouse explicitly discussed modern gender terminology or every family arrangement.

answers.rationale: Human development requires room to revise inherited practices.
Established practices must justify effects on actual freedom.
Social respect should not penalise harmless family differences.
Predetermined sex roles obstruct equal self-development.
Equal civil standing supports extending marriage choice.
Stable caregiving matters more than a categorical household hierarchy.
Early pregnancy choice supports agency with due moral consideration.
Family conscience and children's developing autonomy both need protection.
Caregiving ability should matter more than parental sex.
Customary modesty cannot automatically govern others' self-expression.
Recognition can develop through respectful changes in social usage.
Moral development entails reflection rather than unexamined transmission.
Role choice follows equal opportunities for personal growth.
Reform should consider consequences without treating gradualness as an end.
Knowledge of different lives can reduce arbitrary social exclusion.
Continuity has value, but custom must remain compatible with freedom.

axes.brief: Enabling freedom supports useful innovation with collective safeguards for those bearing risks.
axes.counterEvidence: Organic social interdependence opposes treating individual consent as sufficient where others face durable harm.

answers.rationale: Potential benefits and social risk distribution must both be assessed.
Staged trials help avoid exposing the community prematurely.
Important public infrastructure can justify carefully limited habitat loss.
Patients need robust evidence before widespread medical exposure.
Productivity can improve opportunity when displaced workers receive support.
Habitat integrity and essential public development have competing claims.
Food innovation requires evidence about nutrition and ecological effects.
Healthy people need strong protection against irreversible implant harms.
Technological and behavioural measures should be judged together.
Investigation should precede potentially serious environmental damage.
Basic safety alone may inadequately protect durable effective autonomy.
Reliability across groups is essential to equitable healthcare.
Scientific inquiry must balance future persons' welfare and potential benefit.
Collective ecological exposure warrants long-term safeguards.
Housing and transport enable opportunity, with environmental constraints.
Irreversible collective injury calls for a demanding evidence threshold.

axes.brief: Hobhouse supports devolution and cooperation, while social rights require common minimum standards.
axes.counterEvidence: Decentralisation is not a licence for regions to deprive residents of effective citizenship.

answers.rationale: Devolution brings government closer to practical social needs.
Common rights and protected regional competence require adjudication.
Self-government must be balanced with minorities and shared obligations.
National social guarantees can justify limited overrides, not blanket control.
Regional institutions can adapt within equal constitutional protections.
Locally accountable policing is compatible with national standards.
Shared social provision requires redistribution across rich and poor regions.
Common educational opportunity can coexist with curricular diversity.
Local revenue powers support meaningful devolved responsibility.
National labour minima prevent competition through basic-rights erosion.
Local arrangements should reflect the affected community's consent.
National coverage floors protect social citizenship across regions.
Community self-government is legitimate within equal individual rights.
Limits can prevent tax competition eroding common social provision.
Locally contained effects favour local knowledge and accountability.
Interdependent emergencies require effective coordinated collective action.

axes.brief: Hobhouse describes personality growing through response to surroundings and education, not being mechanically manufactured.
axes.counterEvidence: Growth is not a blank-slate claim: specific biological traits remain a mixed causal model rather than measured doctrine.

answers.rationale: Development and social conditions shape learned conduct centrally.

Hobhouse gives education and development an important causal role but also recognises individual capacities. This representative model keeps both in view without assigning a majority causal share to either in international IQ comparisons; a social-reform programme does not establish that empirical ranking.

Hobhouse describes the repression of women and the undeveloped capacities produced by restricted opportunities (chapter V). This model gives that social formation priority in explaining observed behaviour, without treating equal rights as biological evidence.
Organic individuality allows bodily differences alongside environmental stressors.
Opportunities and education cultivate the range of human interests.
Learning and circumstances qualify any inherited predominance claim.
Cooperation develops through mutual aid and social participation.
Social feeling can be cultivated rather than fixed by inheritance.
Conditions for learning can develop attention and sustained effort.
Moral discipline grows through reasoned social development.
Experience and social relations condition perceived threats.
Personal disposition and development interact without a universal causal ranking.
Taste develops through social experience rather than immutable prescriptions.

Hobhouse explains conduct through social development, institutions and opportunities. Applied cautiously to violent behaviour, that supports examining differing conditions rather than assuming racial biological primacy; his argument for equal rights alone does not establish comparative crime causation.
Hobhouse explicitly explains self-control through learning and self-discipline.

Hobhouse describes restrictions on women entering occupations and the productive capacity lost through their repression (chapters II and V). This supports a social-conditions explanation of pay differences over treating earnings as an independent measure of economic contribution, without quantifying the whole gap.

review.reviewer: Codex independent assessment reviewer /root/socialist_green (separate from author)
review.notes: Independently read all 240 answers against the current bank and checked the scoped primary doctrine plus scholarship/context. No scores or desired locations were consulted. Reviewed literal government authority, ownership versus funding, official religious review versus veto, graduate routes versus guaranteed residence, military initiation versus response, and causal claims versus moral equality. Corrections: culture-nature-16: -2 -> -1; culture-nature-14: -2 -> -1; culture-nature-02: -1 -> 0; culture-nature-03: 1 -> 1; restricted-immigration-open-immigration-12: 0 -> -1; secular-religious-08: -2 -> -2. The inferred modern-policy answers and mixed causal models remain representative applications, not documented answers by every adherent or scientific causal estimates. Similarity review is a subsequent mechanical check. Hobhouse’s chapters II, V, VII and IX include dated colonial assumptions and capacity exceptions; the model applies his self-development principle to the modern questions rather than claiming his period was fully egalitarian in practice. Validation returned zero errors. Explicitly examined neutral-count warnings: planning-free-market 6/16, innovation-caution 5/16. Retained condition-dependent policy tradeoffs and representative interaction models; in particular the Culture vs Nature neutrals withhold causal primacy rather than converting equal rights into empirical proof. High neutrality records weaker doctrinal determination and must not be presented as a precisely measured consensus among adherents. No answers were changed after inspecting validation scores.
